engineering.definitionOfDone: All four packaged platforms report the selected version, build, channel and source.
Distribution advancement and protected channel promotion reject invalid versions and unauthorized changes.
The latest mandatory PR checks pass with independently verified source, workflow and execution freshness.
Required source and packaged scans, dependency review, SBOM and provenance pass for this candidate under the reviewed policy.
Installer and portable startup, update feed, checksum rejection and failed-update recovery pass on a disposable Windows runner.
The packaged Full Host starts and recovers, and subprocess, detached group, PTY and helper-death cleanup leaves no owned process.
Nested executable inventory, minimal entitlements, Hardened Runtime and notarization/stapling preparation pass without production submission.
Identity, privacy and SDK inventory, signing abstraction, archive and export validation pass with uploads disabled.
Reproducible toolchain, release AAB, R8 mapping, signing abstraction and actual API 36 / 16 KiB candidate acceptance pass.
Versioned runtime, Windows, macOS, iOS and Android crash/ANR collectors preserve collection completeness and privacy.
Every required support producer, offline secret scan, consent, cancel and exact-byte save path passes for each supported platform.
Session, settings, trust and native storage use versioned backup-first forward migration with corruption recovery and explicit downgrade limits.
The N/N-1 Host/client corpus covers additive fields, unknown capabilities/events and major/session mismatches.
Platform rehearsals distinguish updater rollback, forward fix, feature kill and migration recovery; store redistribution is not local binary rollback.
Complete engineering DoD, owner roles and evidence owners feed a source-bound Go/No-Go command; external manual actions cannot waive engineering failures.
One source produces all four platform candidates with verified bytes, manifests, checksums, SBOM, provenance and authenticated platform execution.

production.definitionOfDone: Authorized production signing through a protected environment; secret values never enter the checklist.
Authorized external notarization submission and ticket retrieval through a protected environment.
Authorized TestFlight, Play, Microsoft Store or App Store mutation after engineering preparation.
Authorized publication or promotion of already verified immutable artifacts.
Authorized production rollout or pause under the retained rollout policy.
Authorized external developer identity or account submission; account values are not collected here.
